name: Tuttintorno Play: 360° Video Player
summary:
Tuttintorno Play plays the original files of your Insta360 camera on Meta Quest, with no need to export them first.

• 360° videos (.insv) up to 8K: the two lenses are stitched in real time and the camera's gyroscope keeps the horizon level, or locks the whole view.
• 360° photos (.insp), 360° and flat .mp4 and .jpg.
• Open files from the headset, a USB drive or microSD card, the camera connected by cable (U-Disk mode), shared folders on your network (SMB, with automatic discovery) or directly from the came
